title: state.<deviceRef>.<feature>.<stateKey>
description:
An attribute changed (spec §8.3).

The highest-volume topic by a wide margin — an energy meter can produce one per second per device. Plugins may coalesce repeated values for the same attribute rather than pushing every sample; if they do, they should report `degraded` via plugin.health when the drop rate is high enough to matter (spec §11).
